title: 4838: Log warning for duplicate commit IDs in gitGraph
body:
## :bookmark_tabs: Summary

This PR adds a warning log when duplicate commit IDs are encountered in gitGraph. Duplicate commit IDs can lead to incorrect or broken rendering, particularly affecting the chronological layout of commits
Resolves #4838

comments.body:
**question**: I'm not sure if this test is useful. I believe `cy.log` just logs a message to the console, it doesn't test if anything is logged to the console (correct me if I'm wrong).

**suggestion**: Maybe a better way to write this test would be to put it into the `packages/mermaid/src/diagrams/git/gitGraph.spec.ts` file? Then you can use Vitest mocks: https://vitest.dev/guide/mocking to check if the `.warn` function was called with the given error message?
